notes: HISTORY-WINDOW FIX: the requested longer history is retained rather than truncated to five years. AMD and AMZN are absent from the pinned US source watchlist by user request. Results differ in history coverage and US universe from earlier runs; this is not an identical-universe or target-distance-only comparison. Evidence thresholds are unchanged, and feasible sample counts do not establish a trading edge. 2026 YEAR-TO-DATE ENTRY RESEARCH; maximum 45 TRADING SESSIONS, entry is session one. Entries from January 1 through latest completed 2026 exchange session, never future prices. SL/TP may exit earlier; open positions are marked separately, not forced wins/losses. Up to ten years of pre-2026 history are requested and retained when available, without the older five-year truncation. Per-ticker/strategy feasibility audits use only outcomes matured before the first eligible entry open and latest entry open. Feasible sample counts do NOT imply positive edge or trade approval. Later pre-entry matured 2026 outcomes may update the model causally. Same empirical target grid, 20 calibration/10 qualifying walk-forward minimums, positive mean net-R checks and 30-example training window as the 15-session experiment. Targets/stops are not mechanically scaled with holding time. Shorter-listed stocks may lack sufficient empirical evidence and are rejected, not granted looser thresholds. At least 60 pre-January bars are required for price-feature warm-up; exclusions are disclosed. This is a retrospective current-baseline-watchlist study, NOT a reconstructed point-in-time 2026 universe. Known later TSX additions retain their recorded eligibility dates, not January 1. Historical hit rates are descriptive, not forecast probabilities; old regimes and selection bias remain. Compression/balanced/trend-family signals, original pattern stops, empirical targets and labeled fixed-2R controls. Separate USD/CAD accounts, one position at a time, 25% allocation and 1.5% planned equity-risk caps, 15 bps/side; gaps can exceed planned risk. No commissions or dividend cash, daily stop-first fills, fractional broker/order eligibility unverified. Zero entries are not evaluable. Independent scenarios must not be summed as one portfolio. No orders or live strategy promotion. Original October experiments and reports remain unchanged.
